extra.reason: Split linux package modules into desktop/server, moved vlc to desktop.nix, fixed broken system.nix imports, added hosts/linux-server/.gitkeep placeholder. nix flake check --no-build passed.
Added ghostty to hosts/modules/packages/linux/desktop.nix. nix flake check --no-build passed; ghostty appears in apoc system packages evaluation.

Added nix.gc.automatic weekly cleanup with 30d retention to hosts/modules/packages/linux/common.nix, shared by desktop.nix and server.nix. nix flake check --no-build passed; gc config confirmed in apoc evaluation.

Removed ghostty from hosts/modules/packages/linux/desktop.nix because Parallels VM only exposes OpenGL 4.0 and ghostty requires 4.3. Recommended konsole (already installed via KDE) as the native alternative. nix flake check --no-build passed.

Re-added ghostty to apoc desktop packages via symlinkJoin wrapper that sets LIBGL_ALWAYS_SOFTWARE=1, forcing Mesa software rendering (OpenGL 4.5 via llvmpipe) to bypass Parallels VM's OpenGL 4.0 limit. nix flake check --no-build passed; wrapped ghostty confirmed in apoc system packages.
Added ~/.config/ghostty/config for fs@apoc with gtk-single-instance=false to prevent ghostty from opening behind existing windows when launched from KDE icon. nix flake check --no-build passed.
Added home/modules/plasma.nix with kscreenlockerrc and autostart wallpaper for fs@apoc; nix flake check --no-build passed.
Added _stage-flake recipe and called it from all deploy one-shot recipes; just --dump and nix flake check --no-build pass.
Added wispr-flow cask to hosts/modules/packages/darwin/homebrew.nix; nix flake check --no-build passed and just darwin-switch neo installed it.
Overrode nix-homebrew's brew-src input to Homebrew 6.0.13, which includes the cask command_wrapper DSL. just darwin-switch neo now succeeds.
